title: Subramaniapuram
desc: A group of friends known for being notorious find support in an aspiring politician. However, when they kill a man at his behest, he abandons them to fend for themselves.

title: Paarthal Pasu
desc: A corrupt police officer is in cahoots with a notorious criminal in running an illegal brothel. Eventually, an honest policewoman joins hands with her lawyer to expose the officer's crimes.

title: Minsara Kanavu
desc: Thomas, an expatriate, falls in love with Priya, but soon learns that she wants to become a nun. Later, things go awry when he enlists Deva's help to change her mind.

title: Vaitheeswaran
desc: After the death of Saravanan, a sage tells his mother that her son will reincarnate if she never leaves the temple and prays. Thirty years later, an agnostic Dr Bala meets the mother to treat her.

title: Kalakalappu 2
desc: Raghu learns about his father's ancestral property, which is taken care of by Srinivas. When Ganesh cheats both of them, they visit Karaikudi to get hold of Ganesh and recover their money.
